notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-sC runs all default-category NSE scripts automatically. 'Default' scripts are selected by Nmap developers as safe, useful, and non-intrusive for standard enumeration. Runs in parallel with the port scan.

=== CATEGORIES ===
NSE categories: safe, discovery, default, auth, brute, vuln, exploit, intrusive, dos. -sC runs 'default' only. Default scripts include banner grabbing, basic auth testing, SSL cert extraction, protocol capability enumeration.

=== COMBINATION ===
-sC -sV together (-A equivalent without OS detection and traceroute): service version + default scripts on all open ports. Standard starting point for service enumeration.
